Chapter 786: Chapter 9: Heaven, Earth, Man, Ghosts And Gods, All Worship Martial Ancestor (Subscription Requested)_3

Chapter 786: Chapter 9: Heaven, Earth, Man, Ghosts and Gods, All Worship Martial Ancestor (Subscription Requested)_3

“`

Without the World Tree, the entire Tianqing World would have probably been breached long ago, where would the resistance come from?

…

Outside the world.

Two colossal Foreign Evil Gods gazed intently.

“The Pavilion Master’s methods are indeed unfathomable, just one strike, and he tore apart the barrier of this world.”

...

The Foreign Evil God on the left sent out mental fluctuations, faintly brimming with astonishment.

Without the Pavilion Master’s methods, the two of them, as Foreign Evil Gods, would not even talk about invading the Tianqing World, they wouldn’t be able to approach it and would be repelled by the Ancestral Demon Tree.

It was precisely with the Pavilion Master’s methods that they managed to severely injure the Ancestral Demon Tree and tear apart the world barrier, successfully invading.

“It’s a pity that even after heavily injuring the Ancestral Demon Tree, the adversary still has the strength to resist our soul talent pressure; otherwise, all creatures within this entire world would have fallen into the nightmare world we created.”

The Foreign Evil God on the right shook its head, somewhat regretfully.

“That Demon Tree, after tens of thousands of years, its strength has become so formidable? Even the Pavilion Master’s methods couldn’t annihilate it?”

The Foreign Evil God on the left was equally surprised.

They knew how fearsome the Pavilion Master was; over a hundred thousand years ago, he had conquered a certain Secret Realm and greatly increased his strength, far surpassing that of ordinary Evil Gods like themselves.

“It’s just that it doesn’t mean much. Under the Pavilion Master’s methods, it’s already severely injured. If it weren’t for our reluctance to sustain damage, we could have invaded the world by now.”

The Foreign Evil God on the right spoke. With the Ancestral Demon Tree heavily injured, they had the power to invade, but they felt that they would be harmed by the frenzied Ancestral Demon Tree, which was why they did not continue.

After all, the world barrier had already been torn; the rest was merely a matter of time. They just needed to continue to slowly erode the last bit of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s strength, and then they could take the Tianqing World “unharmed.”

…

The World Tree supported the heavens and earth, with countless Martial Dao Cultivators hiding in its trunk, resisting the soul talent suppression from the Foreign Evil Gods.

After tens of thousands of years of development, and under Lin Yuan’s secret guidance, in the Tianqing World, Martial Dao was revered above all. As for the World Tree, it was nothing more than a backup plan left by the great Martial Ancestor.

And the Martial Ancestor was the origin of martial cultivation in the Tianqing World. Without the Martial Ancestor, the Tianqing World would have been destroyed long before in a previous Evil God invasion.

Therefore, for all beings in the Tianqing World, and for the countless Martial Dao Cultivators, there was only one belief in their hearts.

That was the Martial Ancestor.

As for the World Tree? Sheltering the Tianqing World for tens of thousands of years, it too was a contingency left by the Martial Ancestor.

…

At the very top of the World Tree, where the canopy resides,

it was like a vast continent, where countless Martial Dao Cultivators lived, and this place was also the Tianqing World’s last barrier.

Even if the mortal lands were occupied by the Evil Gods, as long as the Canopy Continent was not lost, the beings of the Tianqing World still had a chance, a hope.

In the central most part of the canopy, a temple stood erect. This place was the Martial Hall, and also the place where the ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor was enshrined, considered the ‘sacred realm’ for all creatures of the Tianqing World.

No one in the Tianqing World had seen the Martial Ancestor, but the myth of the Martial Ancestor was present everywhere, and every once in a while, the High Priest of the Martial Hall would lead the beings to worship the Martial Ancestor.

“`

To be precise, in Tianqing World, it is not just all living beings who worship the Martial Ancestor, but also all things and even the whole world itself. During each sacrificial ceremony, the heavens and the earth roar.

Inside the Martial Hall.

Priests moved about, and the many Martial Dao Cultivators on the Canopy Continent, who had suffered the ravages of the Evil God Puppets on the human lands, were also extremely anxious.

They had even held several Martial Ancestor worship ceremonies in succession, hoping to seek the help of the Martial Ancestor to repel the Foreign Evil God and save the living beings of Tianqing World.

But so far, it had not been of much use; the Evil God Puppets were still rampaging. However, the living beings had not begun to doubt their faith in the Martial Ancestor.

…

In the deepest part of the Martial Hall.

A statue of a majestic man was enshrined there, this was the ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor, acquired through the World Tree’s knowledge about the Martial Ancestor’s partial true form and stature.

In fact, this ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor, was none other than what Lin Yuan had commanded the Ancestral Demon Tree to create, spending over a hundred thousand years using the entire Tianqing World as the mother body, pouring in an untold amount of Origin Power, and ultimately nurturing the strongest physique.

The purpose was to prepare for Lin Yuan’s Consciousness Descent.

This way, Lin Yuan was spared a great deal of time starting from scratch. With a hundred thousand years spent by the Ancestral Demon Tree, drawing upon the infinite Origin Power of Tianqing World, the physique it nurtured started at the Eighth Layer.

After being nurtured with worship for over a hundred thousand more years, it had already approached or even reached the Ninth Rank.

This means,

as soon as Lin Yuan descends again into the Tianqing World, he can directly inhabit this body, equivalent to those innately powerful special beings of the Main Universe.

Moreover, this ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor was nurtured from the essence of Martial Tao gathered by Lin Yuan, extremely harmonious with Martial Tao. Once the Consciousness Descent occurs, the time to return to his peak period will be very short.

Only by completely mastering a world could Lin Yuan so lavishly plan and execute such a strategy; otherwise, in other worlds, he would not have the conditions to do so.

Setting other matters aside, such a physique, gathering the essence of heaven and earth, far surpasses any Rare Treasures, and would have long been coveted or even seized by those powerful beings.

But in Tianqing World, protected by the Ancestral Demon Tree, this ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor was able to be successfully nurtured until today.

And it became the source of faith for all the beings of Tianqing World.

Inside the Martial Hall.

Countless people started to worship the Martial Ancestor anew.

Incense smoke filled the air, and countless faithful knelt towards the ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor in the deepest part, and a supreme aura enshrouded them, faintly discernible.

“May the Martial Ancestor take pity on the living beings, descend with mighty power, and repel the Evil God.”

The High Priest, a woman, knelt reverently and prayed to the ‘Golden Body’ of the Martial Ancestor.

At the same time, the branches of the World Tree swayed, an inexplicable aura emerged, and the worship from the heavens and the earth followed closely.

This world.

Heaven, earth, humans, ghosts, and gods.

All worship the Martial Ancestor.

Just at this moment, a strand of will cut through dimensions and descended into the Martial Ancestor Golden Body.
